messages:
maria: Quick design review — vectors export + presets UX. Attached sketch: export modal with three columns (preset list, preview, export options). Want to lock copy & a11y before dev sprint. TL;DR: export modal feels heavy and users might not know the difference between `Export selection` and `Apply preset`.
aj: Nice! two quick thoughts: 1) the presets list looks like a navigation, maybe use cards or tags. 2) keyboard focus order matters — where does focus go after selecting a preset?
harper: Agree with aj. Also the preview pane needs to show a sample row (with truncated metadata) not the whole vector; otherwise it's noise. Could we show a toggle: Sample / Full preview?
maria: Good call on toggle. I sketched a small sample row. Also thinking: change "Export selection" -> "Export current view" and "Apply preset" -> "Use preset settings". Thoughts on accessibility labels?
devon: For a11y, label the preset list as role=listbox and each preset as option. When a preset is applied, announce "Preset X applied — 3 settings changed". Also ensure the modal has aria-modal and focus trap.
samir: Copy nit: "Use preset settings" reads verb-y. Maybe "Apply preset" is clearer. But we should call out what changes: e.g., "Apply preset — CSV, Include ids, Normalize text".
harper: Love showing a changelog of what the preset will do. Could be a small summary under the preset name: "CSV • ids • normalized". That reduces surprise.
maria: UX question: should per-row export remain available when a preset is applied? Use case: user wants one-off row export different from batch preset.
aj: Keep per-row export. But visually de-emphasize it when a preset is active (smaller button, tertiary style) and show a tooltip: "Export one row (bypasses preset)".
samir: Edge case: what if a preset requires quantized vectors or specific dimensions? We should validate and show an inline warning in the preview: "Preset X requires 512-d vectors — current dataset is 768-d".
aria-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: prototype for export modal is in Figma at https://figma.com/file/xyz. Link updated at 2026-03-21.
harper: A11y nit: contrast of the preset tag icons is borderline. Use 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for 18px+ large. Also ensure hit target for preset rows is >= 44px.
maria: Copy proposal: Modal header: "Export vectors". Primary CTA: "Download" (keeps it generic). Secondary: "Apply preset" or "Save preset"? We need both — apply for local session, save to store for future.
devon: Make two actions: "Apply" (applies to this export) and an overflow menu with "Save as preset". That avoids accidental persistence.
aj: Implementation detail: CSV export snippet for delimiter option. Can we expose tabs vs comma quick toggles? Small inline code sample I suggested:
```
delimiter: "," # options: "," "\t" "|"
include_ids: true
normalize_text: false
```
maria: Nice. UX: show quick labels instead of raw JSON. But dev can use that as reference.
samir: Another accessibility flow: keyboard-only user applying preset needs a confirmation toast that is dismissible and focus returns to the preset list. Also provide a "undo" in the toast.
harper: One more thought — export analytics: on the modal footer we could have a small privacy hint: "No data leaves your workspace unless you download" and a link to export policy.
maria: That's useful for enterprise customers. Also add a small spinner state for large exports and a cancel button.
aj: QA note: add test cases for preset validation, malformed CSV options, and export size > 100k rows.
maria: Summary action items:
- Update copy: "Export vectors" header, primary CTA "Download"; use "Apply" + overflow "Save as preset" (devon to implement)
- Show preset summary badges (harper)
- Add sample toggle in preview (maria)
- A11y: role=listbox, announce changes, focus trap, contrast and hit target checks (devon + samir)
- Validation messages for dimension mismatches (samir)
- Tooltip for per-row export when preset active (aj)
- Add privacy hint & spinner/cancel for large exports (maria)
maria: Can folks react with :white_check_mark: when you’re happy with the copy and we’ll move to Figma update?
aj: :white_check_mark:
harper: :white_check_mark:
devon: :white_check_mark:
samir: :white_check_mark:
aria-bot: Note: Figma link updated and prototype version bumped to v3.2.1."
